AppEvent.description: Pushed on `app.events` (spec §2.7). One subscription per page.

oneOf.description: Once a second while a stream with a `streamId` runs, and once when it ends (spec §2.5).

bytesPerSec.description: Bytes sent per second over the last interval.

done.description: `true` on the last event of the stream.

dropped.description: Items a push-only source dropped because the client was not reading.

matched.description: Items that passed the filter and were sent.

ratePerSec.description: Matched items per second over the last interval.

oneOf.description: A terminal ended; `term.*` calls on it answer `NotFound` from now on.

certificateFingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the server certificate, `AB:CD:…`, for About.

codecs.description: Payload codecs the server decodes (the messaging core, TSK-80).

listen.description: The address the server listens on.

ApprovalRequiredDetails.description:
`details` of an `ApprovalRequired` error raised by the authorizer: the id of the recorded
approval request.

Archival.description: Whether closed workflows' histories or visibility records are archived, and where.

uri.description: The archive's URI when one is set.

metadata.description: Assistants whose metadata contains these keys and values.

Code.description:
Error codes, spec §10. Serialized as the variant name so TypeScript can narrow on
`e.code === "ApprovalRequired"`.

messageType.description: Protobuf: the fully qualified message type.

ComposePayload.description: What the Composer sends for a key or a value (spec §5.7).

messageType.description: Protobuf: the fully qualified message type.

text.description: What the user typed: text, JSON, hex or base64.

wireFormat.description: `confluent` by default when the schema comes from the registry.

ConnectEchoProfile.description: The echo tool's profile as `toConnect` builds it (spec §4.4).

mappings.description: Mappings of local schemas to the topic `echo` (the profile's `extras.mappings`).

schemas.description: Local schemas for the test topic's messages (the profile's `extras.schemas`).

token.description: A stand-in secret: `"wrong"` is refused with `Auth`. Never logged.

ConnectLanggraphProfile.description: The LangGraph profile as `toConnect` builds it (spec §11.1).

headers.description: Extra headers (custom auth), sent with every request.

tls.description: For `https` URLs: a pinned CA, a client certificate, the expected name.

ConnectTemporalProfile.description: The Temporal profile as `toConnect` builds it (spec §9.1).

clientKeyPem.description: The client certificate's private key (PEM); never logged.

namespace.description: The namespace opened first; `default` when empty.

ConnectionState.description: The state of a live handle (spec §2.2, "Status").

maxPayloadBytes.description: Inline payload bytes per message; 1 MiB when absent.

schemaIssues.description: Local schemas that did not compile, with file and line.

partition.description: The partition; by the key's hash, or round robin, when absent.

offset.description: Decimal, as every offset on the wire.

EchoStart.description: Where a tail starts (Kafka's words: the test topic behaves as a Kafka topic).

oneOf.description: The last `n` messages of each partition.

follow.description: Keep reading new messages; else stop at the end as of the start.

maxScan.description: Messages read before a filtered scan stops; 0 for no limit, 100,000 with a filter.

push.description: Push-only, as core NATS: new messages only, dropped when the client does not read.

count.description: Ticks to send before ending; until stopped when absent.

intervalMs.description: Time between ticks, 0 to 60,000 ms; 100 when absent.

oneOf.description: The source has no more messages (a browse reached its end).

ErrorPosition.description: Where in an input text an error is, 1-based (a codec's JSON, a schema, a jq program).

EventCategory.description: What an event is about, for the History filter and the Timeline's lanes.

FilterIssue.description: A problem with one part of a filter (`messaging.filter.check`).

fromEventId.description: The last event the screen has; only later events are sent.

closed.description: The run closed: there is nothing more to follow.

FullMessage.description: A whole message, for "Load full payload" (spec §5.1).

conditional.description: A branch of a conditional edge (drawn dashed).

id.description: Unique in the graph; with xray, a subgraph's nodes are `<subgraph>:<node>`.

metadata.description: The node's metadata, when it has any.

HeaderFilter.description: A header that must be present, and match when `match` is given.

HeaderInput.description: A header as the UI sends it (Composer, KeyValueEditor): text or base64.

HeaderPair.description: An extra header of the profile (custom auth); its value is a secret.

HistoryEvent.description: One event of a workflow's history.

attributes.description: The event's own attributes, as protobuf JSON, payloads decoded.

InspectSchema.description: A schema to inspect: a reference, or a local schema not saved yet (the schema editor).

example.description: An example payload as JSON text.

jsonSchema.description: The JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of the codec's JSON.

messageTypes.description: Protobuf: the message types offered; empty for the other types.

text.description: The schema text (Avro, `.proto` main file or JSON Schema).

Interrupt.description: A pending `interrupt()`: its value is what the graph asks the human.

version.description: The LangGraph API version, when the server says it.

LastPosition.description:
Where a stream stopped, per source and partition: the last message read, so a restart
continues at the next one (offset + 1, sequence + 1). Decimal strings keep 64 bits exact.

timestampUs.description: Microseconds since the epoch, of the last message read.

LocalSchema.description: A schema the user added to a profile (spec §4.2, `extras.schemas`).

messageTypes.description: Protobuf: the message types offered (all top-level messages of the first file when absent).

LocalSchemaFiles.description: The sources of a local schema: files, or a compiled Protobuf `FileDescriptorSet`.

oneOf.description: A NATS subject pattern with `*` and `>`.

activeCluster.description: The cluster that accepts writes; empty when the server did not say.

capabilities.description:
The features the namespace reports as on, by their camelCase proto names
(`eagerWorkflowStart`, `standaloneActivities`, ...).

NamespaceLimits.description: The size limits the namespace enforces, in bytes, when the server reports them.

blobSizeLimitError.description: A payload larger than this fails the workflow task (Temporal's default: 2 MiB).

isDefault.description: The namespace the profile opened first.

retentionSecs.description: How long closed workflows are kept, in seconds.

Part.description: Which part of a message a codec reads or writes.

PositionRange.description: An inclusive range of offsets or sequences, as decimal strings.

RegistryRef.description: A schema in the registry, by id or by subject and version.

RemoteError.description: The target's own error code, for Details.

code.description: Kafka error name, gRPC status, HTTP status, Kubernetes `Status.reason`, NATS error code.

ResetReapply.description: Which signals a reset re-applies to the new run.

oneOf.description: Every eligible event after the reset point (signals and updates).

RunCommand.description: `Command` of a run: resume an interrupt, update the state, go to a node.

goto.description: A node name, or a list of them.

lastEventId.description: The id of the last event forwarded (for `langgraph.runs.join`).

status.description: The run's status when its stream ended (`success`, `error`, `interrupted`, ...).

lastEventId.description:
The id of the last event seen: the stream resumes after it. From the run's current
event when absent; `-1` replays the run from its start.

assistantId.description: An assistant id or a graph id.

interruptBefore.description: Node names, or `["*"]` for every node.

multitaskStrategy.description: `reject`, `rollback`, `interrupt` or `enqueue` when the thread is busy.

threadId.description: The thread to run on; `null` for a run without a thread.

scheduledTime.description: When it should have run, RFC 3339.

status.description: `Running`, `Completed`, ... as the workflow's status, when the server says it.

ScheduleDetail.description: Everything `DescribeSchedule` says; the parts are protobuf JSON, payloads decoded.

action.description: `schedule.action`: the workflow it starts (type, id, task queue, input).

info.description: `info`: action counts, running workflows, create and update times.

policies.description: `schedule.policies`: overlap, catch-up window, pause on failure.

spec.description: `schedule.spec`: intervals, calendars, cron strings, jitter, time zone.

ScheduleOverlap.description: What to do when a triggered run meets one that is still running.

note.description: The note shown with the pause or unpause.

overlap.description: For `trigger`: the schedule's own policy when absent.

notes.description: The note of the last pause or unpause.

query.description: A schedule visibility query; every schedule when empty.

SchemaFile.description: One source file of a local schema.

SchemaIssue.description: A problem found compiling a schema, with the file and line when known (spec §5.3).

schemaId.description: The local schema's id, when the issue is about one.

SchemaMapping.description: A local schema mapped to messages (spec §4.2, `extras.mappings`).

SchemaRef.description: Where a schema comes from (spec §5.7): `{ registry: … }` or `{ local: schemaId }`.

SchemaVersion.description: A registry schema version: a number or `"latest"`.

issues.description: Schemas that do not compile, with file and line; the others are in use.

SearchAttribute.description: One attribute a query can name.

custom.description: Registered for the namespace by its users, not built in.

SearchAttributeType.description: The value type of a search attribute (`IndexedValueType`).

SearchAttributesOutput.description: The namespace's attributes: custom ones first, then the built-in ones, each by name.

fallback.description: Set when the server did not list them and these are the built-in ones only: its message.

error.description: Why the queue could not be described.

StateTask.description: A task of the next step: the node to run, its error, its interrupts.

state.description: A subgraph task's own state (when asked for subgraphs).

score.description: Relevance of a semantic search hit.

filter.description: Items whose value has these fields and values.

query.description: Natural-language query (semantic search, when the store has an index).

TailSummary.description: The summary of a message stream (spec §5.5, `TailSummary`).

Target.description:
Where a message lives, for mappings and subject naming: a Kafka topic, a NATS subject (core
or JetStream) or a KV bucket.

workflowBacklog.description: Tasks waiting for a poller, when the server reports it.

TaskQueueSource.description: Where a task queue was found.

TemporalCapabilities.description: What the server reports about itself.

visibilityStore.description:
Which store holds visibility (`cassandra`, `mysql8`, `postgres12`, `sqlite`,
`elasticsearch`, ...); empty when the cluster did not say. Cassandra has basic visibility
only, so the list's query bar is limited (spec §9.3).

clusterName.description: The cluster's name, when it reported one.

TemporalTlsOptions.description:
TLS settings of a profile (spec §4.2 `TemporalTlsOptions`); `secrets.clientKeyPem` comes beside it as
`clientKeyPem`. There is no "skip verification" (spec Open question 6).

caPem.description: Extra trusted CA certificates (PEM); the operating system's roots are used as well.

serverName.description: The name to verify the server certificate against, when it is not the address's host.

data.description: The bytes typed or pasted, base64; at most 64 KiB decoded.

before.description: Checkpoints older than this one (the next page).

ThreadState.description: A thread's state at a checkpoint (`GET /threads/{id}/state`, one entry of the history).

interrupts.description: Every pending interrupt of the state, its tasks' included.

next.description: The nodes the next step runs; empty when the graph has ended.

checkpointId.description: The state at this checkpoint (time travel); the current state when absent.

subgraphs.description: Include the subgraphs' states in the tasks.

TimeRange.description: An inclusive range of RFC 3339 times.

TlsOptions.description:
TLS settings of a profile, as `toConnect` sends them (spec §4.2). `clientKeyPem` comes from
the profile's `secrets`; procedures that take it list it in `redact`.

caPem.description: PEM certificates of the CA to trust instead of the system's trust store.

clientCertPem.description: PEM client certificate (chain) for mutual TLS.

clientKeyPem.description: PEM private key of the client certificate. A secret.

enabled.description: Use TLS. Tools whose address says it (`https://`) use TLS either way.

serverName.description: The name the server's certificate must carry, when it is not the address's host.

field.description: For `Invalid`: the input field at fault, as the UI names it.

position.description: For `Invalid`: where in the field's text, when known.

system.description: The tool id (`nats`, `kafka`, `k8s`, ...), or `app` for shared procedures.

ToolErrorKind.description: What went wrong, as the UI needs to know it (spec §2.6).

oneOf.description: The target refused, timed out or is unreachable.
The TLS handshake or verification failed.
The SSH host key is unknown or changed.
The target denied the operation (ACL, RBAC, permissions).
The named resource does not exist, or the `connId` is gone (`resource = "connection"`).
Exists already, wrong revision, not empty, not running.
Input the target or a codec rejected.
Any other target error, with its native code in `remote`.

ToolInfo.description: A tool built into the server.

version.description: The version of the tool's main library, or of the server for built-in samples.

asNode.description: The node the update is made as (the graph continues from its edges).

checkpointId.description: Update the state at this checkpoint, which forks a new branch from it.

values.description: The values to write, as a node's update.

WireFormat.description: Whether encoding writes the Confluent wire format (spec §5.3).

WorkerRow.description: One worker on one task queue.

buildId.description: The build id it reports (worker versioning or deployment options).

lastAccessTime.description: Its latest poll on either kind, RFC 3339.

ratePerSecond.description: Tasks per second over both kinds, as the server measures it.

taskQueues.description: Task queues to describe besides the ones seen.

truncated.description: More task queues were seen than one call describes (50); typed ones come first.

autoResetPoints.description: `ResetPointInfo[]`: the points the server can reset to by itself.

memo.description: The memo's fields by name, decoded.

pendingActivities.description: `PendingActivityInfo[]`: type, state, attempt, last failure, heartbeat details, times.

searchAttributes.description: The search attributes by name, decoded.

args.description: Each argument is sent as one `json/plain` payload.

queryType.description: `__stack_trace`, or a query the workflow defines.

result.description: The result payloads decoded: the value when there is one, an array of them otherwise.

reason.description: Required to terminate; optional to ask for cancellation.

WorkflowRef.description: Names a workflow run: the run id is the latest run when absent.

eventId.description: The event to reset to: a WorkflowTaskCompleted, WorkflowTaskStarted or failed task event.

WorkflowRow.description: One row of the workflow list.

durationMs.description: Close (or now, while running) minus start, in milliseconds, as the server reports it.

args.description: Each argument is sent as one `json/plain` payload.

WorkflowStatus.description: The execution status of a workflow (`WorkflowExecutionStatus`).

WorkflowsCountOutput.description: The number of workflows a query matches.

query.description:
A visibility query (`WorkflowType = "Order" AND ExecutionStatus = "Running"`); every
workflow when empty.

Xray.description: How deep to draw subgraphs: `true` all the way, a number that many levels, `false` none.
